purpose: Stable workflow identifiers used by capability atoms and evidence records.

workflows.summary: Read AEP/RIFX structure and expose low-level project data.
Build detailed semantic profiles for comparison, reporting, and learning.
Generate AEP projects from recipe-level intent and serializer templates.
Convert projects between supported AE writer versions with explicit boundaries for version-gated features.
Open generated or migrated AEPs in installed After Effects hosts to validate compatibility.
Harvest fixtures, profiles, gaps, and host-open results into reusable AEP understanding.
Expose learned capabilities so AI or higher-level tools can generate project workflows.
Compare rendered output when profile equivalence is not enough.
